# relay_private_endpoint (Resource)

Registers a cloud-side endpoint on a `relay_private_endpoint_service`. The platform accepts the connection on its side; creating waits until it is `AVAILABLE` and the workspace's databases answer on `<name>-pl-<index>` hostnames from inside the endpoint's network. Destroying rejects the connection and waits until the registration is gone. AWS never accepts a rejected VPC endpoint again, so registering the same `vpc_endpoint_id` after its registration was destroyed fails with `REJECTED`; replace the `aws_vpc_endpoint` with it, for example with `replace_triggered_by`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_private_endpoint_service" "use1" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  cloud        = "aws"
  region       = "us-east-1"
}

resource "aws_security_group" "relay" {
  name   = "relay-private-endpoint"
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.app.id

  ingress {
    from_port   = 5432
    to_port     = 5432
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [aws_vpc.app.cidr_block]
  }
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "relay" {
  vpc_id             = aws_vpc.app.id
  service_name       = relay_private_endpoint_service.use1.endpoint_service_name
  vpc_endpoint_type  = "Interface"
  subnet_ids         = aws_subnet.private[*].id
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.relay.id]
}

resource "relay_private_endpoint" "app" {
  workspace_id    = relay_workspace.prod.id
  service_id      = relay_private_endpoint_service.use1.id
  vpc_endpoint_id = aws_vpc_endpoint.relay.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) `relay_private_endpoint_service` to register on.
- `vpc_endpoint_id` (String) AWS interface VPC endpoint ID (`vpce-…`), usually `aws_vpc_endpoint.<name>.id`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the service belongs to.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider, from the service.
- `connection_status` (String) `PENDING`, `PENDING_ACCEPTANCE`, `AVAILABLE`, `REJECTED`, `FAILED` or `DELETING`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `dns_name` (String) Regional DNS name of the cloud endpoint, which the `-pl-<index>` hostnames point at.
- `error_message` (String) Why the connection failed, when it did.
- `id` (String) Endpoint ID.
- `index` (Number) Per-workspace index in the endpoint's hostnames (`<name>-pl-<index>`). Never reused.
- `region` (String) Cloud region, from the service.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_private_endpoint.app <workspace_id>/<service_id>/<vpc_endpoint_id>
terraform import relay_private_endpoint.app <workspace_id>/<service_id>/<endpoint_id>
```
